mapper.sql: SELECT p.project_id, p.project_name, p.category_id, c.category_name, p.user_id AS maker_id, u.user_name AS maker_name, p.approval_status, p.project_status, p.reject_reason, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.target_amount, p.created_at, IFNULL(fs.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount, IFNULL(fs.supporter_count, 0) AS supporter_count, IFNULL(lk.like_count, 0) AS like_count, IFNULL(rw.reward_count, 0) AS reward_count, IFNULL(p.project_status = 'in_progress' AND p.end_date >= #{today}, 0) AS funding_open FROM project p JOIN category c ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN `user` u ON u.user_id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT f.project_id, SUM(r.reward_price) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS supporter_count FROM funding f JOIN reward r ON r.reward_id = f.reward_id GROUP BY f.project_id) fs ON fs.project_id = p.project_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS like_count FROM project_like GROUP BY project_id) lk ON lk.project_id = p.project_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS reward_count FROM reward GROUP BY project_id) rw ON rw.project_id = p.project_id

choose.when: ORDER BY total_amount DESC, p.project_id DESC
ORDER BY funding_open DESC, p.end_date ASC, p.project_id ASC
ORDER BY like_count DESC, p.project_id DESC
choose.otherwise: ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.project_id DESC

mapper.select: WHERE p.user_id = #{makerId} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.project_id DESC
WHERE p.approval_status = #{status} ORDER BY p.created_at ASC, p.project_id ASC

SELECT project_id, project_name, project_description, approval_status, reject_reason, project_status, start_date, end_date, target_amount, created_at, user_id AS maker_id, category_id FROM project WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project (project_name, project_description, approval_status, reject_reason, project_status, start_date, end_date, target_amount, created_at, user_id, category_id) VALUES (#{projectName}, #{projectDescription}, #{approvalStatus}, #{rejectReason}, #{projectStatus}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{targetAmount}, IFNULL(#{createdAt}, NOW()), #{makerId}, #{categoryId})
mapper.update: UPDATE project SET approval_status = 'waiting', reject_reason = NULL WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND approval_status IN ('draft', 'reject')
UPDATE project SET approval_status = 'approved', project_status = 'in_progress' WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND approval_status = 'waiting'

UPDATE project p SET p.project_status = CASE WHEN (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(r.reward_price), 0) FROM funding f JOIN reward r ON r.reward_id = f.reward_id WHERE f.project_id = p.project_id) >= p.target_amount THEN 'success' ELSE 'fail' END WHERE p.approval_status = 'approved' AND p.project_status = 'in_progress' AND p.end_date < #{today}
